verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in AI palette, opened with cmd j on highlighted text. It runs preset prompts such as 'list action-items' and free-form custom prompts, and users can chat with filtered notes, with a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. This is a real in-product AI assistant you can hand text tasks to, but it is scoped to transforming selected text and answering questions about notes rather than autonomously carrying out delegated work. Missing for 10: agentic multi-step task execution, the assistant acting on notes or the app itself (creating or organizing notes, running integrations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: To use it, first highlight some text, and then press cmd j (or control j on Windows). That'll popup the AI palette.
You can select from one of our dozen or so prompts, like ‘list key takeaways’ or ‘list action-items’.
You can also ask the AI palette anything you'd like using the open text field, and save it as a custom prompt to quickly call on again later.
After applying any desired filters to the search, you can also “chat” with those specific notes to ask questions and extract information.
